title: Interstellar
description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole to find a habitable planet and save humanity.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded on Mars uses science and ingenuity to survive while waiting for rescue.

title: Gravity
description: Two astronauts fight to survive after a space disaster leaves them stranded far from Earth.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and attempts to plant an idea in someone's mind.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A clownfish crosses the ocean to find his missing son and faces dangerous challenges along the way.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling father overcomes financial hardship while pursuing a better future for his son.
